    Smarty Pants Section

    Who Can Guess These Binomials?

    Binomials are pairs of words joined by “and”, like rock and roll. They’re some of the most popular idioms in English. Can you fill in all eight?

    Answers coming in2:00:00

    The answers

    • Awear and tear
    • Bpeace and quiet
    • Chustle and bustle
    • Dsafe and sound
    • Eloud and clear
    • Fsick and tired
    • Gfacts and figures
    • Hheart and soul
